title: 43. The ſecond point is of the thing ſignified in the Sacramentes.

segments.text: THe promyſes whereto the Sacramentes bee ioyned as Autentyke ſeales, tende to one onely Ieſus Chriſt. For it is he onelye which is declared to vs, and repreſented with all his goodnes & treaſours by the ſignes of ſacramentes, and by that word which is ioyned with it for to quicken and confirme ou• fayth, wherewith we doo embrace him, and to aduertiſe vs of our duety, a•well towarde him as towardes our neyghboures.
